fields.name: Core Message / Action Item
fields.expected: Entine forwards a discussion in which Keith Kloor explains and defends how a Nature story was edited and addresses an objection to its headline.
fields.predicted: Jon Entine forwards an email exchange between himself and Keith Kloor regarding a story Keith wrote. Jon had praised the story as "very fair" but questioned the use of "close ties" in the headline, calling it incorrect and inflammatory. Keith responds explaining that the "close ties" line was added during final edits without his knowledge, acknowledges Kevin Folta's objection to it as fair, and suggests that Jon and he should talk since Jon appears in the emails.
